docs.title: Banquet Deposits
docs.text: How to sell a banquet deposit prior to the event.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Open Clover Dining → on the Bar tab, tap the + button (bottom right) to open a new order
  2. Add the DEPOSIT PRIOR TO EVENT item from the BQ Deposits category — the price is variable and must be typed
  3. Tap the green Pay button to get to the payment screen → accept the payment

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Open Clover Dining → on the Bar tab, tap the + button (bottom right) to open a new order
  2. Add the DEPOSIT PRIOR TO EVENT item from the BQ Deposits category — the price is variable and must be typed
  3. Tap the green Pay button (top left) → tap Pay (bottom right) → accept the payment

docs.title: Banquet Orders
docs.text: Banquet orders are entered into the POS the day of the banquet.

docs.title: Create the banquet order
docs.text:
1. Log in with the banquet PIN — 0300 (AM) or 0400 (PM)
  2. Open Clover Dining → tap the Banquet tab at the top
  3. Select the appropriate AM or PM banquet table — this creates the banquet order
  4. Add the items from the banquet menu

Note

If the device is not on the banquet menu, see General → Menu Selection.

docs.title: Banquet Bar
docs.text: A banquet bar is either a cash bar or an open bar.

docs.title: Cash bar
docs.text:
Cash bar sales are sold separately from the banquet order, under the banquet bar PIN login:

  • BANQUET BAR AM — PIN 0301
  • BANQUET BAR PM — PIN 0401

Once logged in under the banquet cash bar PIN, use the Bar tab to create orders as needed.

docs.title: Open bar
docs.text:
For an open bar, the bartender stays logged in under the same PIN used to create the banquet order. Do not switch to the banquet cash bar PINs.

The bartender can set up the open bar in one of two ways.

Guests on the banquet order

  1. Move the banquet food and all other items to Guest 1
  2. Add Guest 2 → add all of the open bar items to Guest 2

Tip

To set up multiple guests on the order, see Updating Orders → Modify Guest Count.

A separate open bar order

As an alternative, create an entirely new order to hold the open bar:

  1. Open Clover Dining → tap the Banquet tab at the top
  2. Select the corresponding BANQUET BAR AM or BANQUET BAR PM table — this creates the open bar order

At checkout, this order can be merged with the main banquet order if the customer wants to pay with one check.

When the customer is ready to pay, they can pay as two checks or one. See Pay for a banquet below.

docs.title: Add the gratuity
docs.text: The added gratuity must be calculated manually and added to the order as an item, from the BQ Added Grat category. The price is variable and must be entered.

docs.title: Pay for a banquet
docs.text: Paying for a banquet is two steps. The first only applies if there was an open bar.

docs.title: 1. Set up the checks (open bar only)
docs.text:
If there was an open bar, ask the customer how they want to pay, and adjust the order on the POS to match:

  • Two checks — print individual bills, then use Split By Guest at checkout. See Closing Orders → Take Payment.
  • One check (banquet order and open bar combined) — select Print Entire Bill, then tap the green Pay button to take payment for the whole order. See Closing Orders → Take Payment.

If the open bar is a separate order, pay it as its own check, or merge it with the main banquet order for one check. See Updating Orders → Combining Tables.

docs.title: 2. Apply the banquet deposit
docs.text:
Once the order is ready to be paid, the banquet deposit must be applied at checkout, as a custom tender, to pay down the order by an amount equal to the banquet deposit.

Warning

If the open bar is being paid as a separate check, apply the banquet deposit to the primary banquet order, not the open bar.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Tap the green Pay button → on the payment screen, tap Split Custom Amount at the top
  2. Select Custom → enter the amount of the banquet deposit → tap Pay
  3. At the bottom under Other, tap Banquet Deposit
  4. The remaining balance shows → tap Next Payment → tap Pay
  5. Take the remaining payment from the customer as normal

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green Pay button (top left) → tap the green Pay button (bottom right)
  2. On the payment screen, tap the three dots (top right) → select Split Custom Amount
  3. Select Custom → enter the amount of the banquet deposit → tap Pay
  4. At the bottom under Other, tap Banquet Deposit
  5. The remaining balance shows → tap the green Take Next Payment button → tap Pay
  6. Take the remaining payment from the customer as normal

docs.title: Issue a drink chip
docs.text:
1. From the DRINK CHIP menu category, add the drink chip item to the order
  2. The price is variable — type the amount of the drink chip
  3. Write the value of the drink chip on the sticker

docs.title: Redeem a drink chip
docs.text:
The value of a drink chip must be applied to the order manually, using the Drink Chip custom tender.

Warning

Only apply a drink chip at checkout, as payment is being taken.

docs.title: If the order is only for the one drink
docs.text: 1. On the payment screen, at the bottom under Other, select Drink Chip to pay for the order in full

docs.title: If the drink chip does not cover the full order balance
docs.text:
1. Tap the green Pay button → on the payment screen, tap Split Custom Amount at the top
  2. Select Custom → type the amount of the drink chip to pay the order down by that amount → tap Pay
  3. At the bottom under Other, select Drink Chip
  4. The remaining balance shows → tap Next Payment → pay for the remainder of the order

docs.title: Employee Shift Drink
docs.text: The employee shift drink discount will apply 100% off to the drink itself.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Open a bar order → add the shift drink
  2. Tap the drink on the left → tap the blue ADD DISCOUNT text
  3. Select Employee Shift Drink (100%)
  4. Tap Pay and select $0.00 to complete the discounted order

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Open a bar order → add the shift drink
  2. Tap the green Pay button (top left)
  3. Tap the drink on the left → tap the blue ADD DISCOUNT text
  4. Select Employee Shift Drink (100%)
  5. Tap Pay and select $0.00 to complete the discounted order

docs.title: Record Cash Events
docs.text:
Cash events record the reason for putting cash in or taking cash out of the register. Common use: server tip payouts.

  1. Open Clover Dining
  2. Tap the three dots in the top right → tap Open Cash Drawer
  3. Select Add or Remove
  4. Enter the amount and reason → tap Continue (right side)
    • For tip payouts, enter tips - <server first name> as the reason
  5. The drawer opens automatically — add or remove the cash as recorded

Note

Cash events are recorded on the Bartender → Terminal Settlement Report.

docs.title: Terminal Settlement Report
docs.text:
The Terminal Settlement Report shows all transactions for the bartender's shift, including all cash events.

  1. Launch the TSR app from the Clover home screen
  2. The app auto-detects and populates the current shift for the bartender PIN logged into the device
  3. If the shift dates are incorrect, manually update them
  4. Tap Generate Report — the report displays in the right panel
  5. Tap Print Report to print

docs.title: Bill Printing
docs.text:
There are two options for printing bills: Print Entire Bill or Print Individual Bills.

  • Print Entire Bill prints the full order on one bill.
  • Print Individual Bills prints a separate bill per guest. Items assigned to whole table are split equally across each guest's bill.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text: From the order, tap one of the two buttons at the bottom — Print Entire Bill or Print Individual Bills.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green pay button (top left) → tap three dots (bottom right)
  2. Choose Print Entire Bill or Print Individual Bills

Note

Regardless of which print format is chosen, payment can still accommodate any combination of guests. See Closing Orders → Take Payment.

docs.title: Large Table Gratuity
docs.text:
A 20% gratuity can be added for large tables at the server's discretion. This adds a required 20% tip to the printed bill.

In Clover, this required gratuity is called a Service Charge.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Tap the three dots on the bottom bar
  2. Select Add Service Charge (20.0%)

The service charge shows up right away on the order summary.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green Pay button (top left) → tap the three dots (bottom right)
  2. Select Add Service Charge (20.0%)

The service charge shows up right away on the order summary.

docs.title: Refunding Payments
docs.text:
Refund a payment when an order was closed by mistake, then take payment again the right way. Use this when:

  • An order was paid with the wrong tender, such as cash instead of credit
  • A payment was applied to the wrong order, such as a customer's credit card closing someone else's order
  • An old gift card or drink chip was used incorrectly. Each is worth a specific amount, so when it does not cover the whole order it must be applied with Split Custom Amount as a partial payment (see Gift Cards & Coupons → Old Gift Cards and Bartender → Drink Chips). If the Old Gift Card or Drink Chip custom tender is accidentally used to pay the order in full, refund it, then pay again with the proper split.

docs.title: Find the order
docs.text:
Once an order is closed, it no longer shows in Clover Dining.

  1. Tap the circle button in the bottom Android navigation bar to go to the home screen
  2. Open the Orders app
  3. Find the order and tap its row

docs.title: Refund the payment
docs.text:
1. Tap Refund (top right) → select Refund Payment
  2. Tap the payment to refund

  3. Tap the red button in the top right:

    • Refund for cash or a custom tender
    • Void for credit

  4. Select the reason for the refund. The payment is refunded.

docs.title: Take the correct payment
docs.text:
1. Tap the back button in the bottom Android navigation bar to return to the order
  2. The button in the top right is now a green Add Payment button — tap it and take the correct payment

Refunding a credit card payment

The card must be swiped again to charge it for the correct amount. If the customer has left and the card is no longer available, handle it the same way as the old POS — call the customer or escalate to the office manager.

docs.title: Take Payment
docs.text:
Payment can be split across several methods. The split method is independent of the format used to print the bill — see Closing Orders → Bill Printing.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text: Tap the green Pay button under the order summary on the left. The payment screen opens with the default of one payment for the full order. Alternative payment options appear as tabs across the top. Select the desired tab to take each payment.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green pay box (top left) → tap the green Pay button (bottom right)
  2. The payment screen opens with the default of one payment for the full order. To switch modes, tap the three dots (top right).

docs.title: Payment options
docs.text:
• Split Custom Amount — can be used to split the full order amount evenly among all guests, or any other split the guests want.
  • Split By Items — select specific items to include in this payment.
  • Split By Guest — pay each guest's individual bill. A single guest can also cover the bill for a subset of guests.

docs.title: Pay Full Amount
docs.text: The default payment screen accepts payment for the full amount of the order. Swipe the credit card or enter the amount of cash paid to complete the transaction. If credit is used, the receipt prints automatically. If cash is used, the POS prompts the server to optionally print the receipt.

docs.title: Split Payment
docs.text:
If the order is paid across more than one payment:

  1. After each payment, the receipt prints automatically if credit was used. If cash was used, the POS prompts the server to optionally print the receipt. The remaining order total then appears.
  2. Tap Next Payment to take the next partial payment
  3. The order remains open and the table remains seated until the full order total has been covered

docs.title: Tip Adjustment
docs.text:
Record tips that customers handwrite on their printed credit-card receipts.

Prerequisite

The order must be closed with at least one credit payment, and the guest must have written the tip on the printed receipt.

  1. Note the Transaction number on the printed receipt where the guest wrote the tip
  2. From the home screen, launch the Tips app
  3. Find the row where Trans # matches the transaction number on the receipt
  4. Tap the row — a keypad opens for the tip amount
  5. Enter the tip — the Total auto-calculates from Subtotal + Tip
  6. Tap Done (top right on Flex, bottom left on Station)

The tip is recorded. The Tips app stays open to enter more tips.

docs.title: Unpaid Orders
docs.text: Use this when a customer walks out and leaves the order unpaid. Print the bill as a record of what is owed, then cancel the order.

docs.title: Print the bill
docs.text:
• On Station: tap Print Entire Bill in the bottom bar.
  • On Flex: tap the green Pay button (top left) → tap the three dots (bottom right) → tap Print Entire Bill.

Keep the printed bill as the record that the order is unpaid, for the next time the customer comes in.

docs.title: Cancel the order
docs.text:
This can be done right away, or the order can be saved and cancelled at the end of the shift.

  1. Go to the order summary:

    • On Station: the order summary is on the left.
    • On Flex: tap the green Pay button (top left).

  2. Tap each item, then:

    • Void it if it has been printed — select a reason.
    • Delete it if it has not been printed.

  3. Once every item has been removed, tap back — the order is deleted.

Note

Manager approval may be required to void an item. See Updating Orders → Remove or Void Items.

docs.title: Menu Selection
docs.text:
Three menus are available:

  • Default POS Menu
  • Banquet Drinks
  • Banquet Food

To switch between them:

  1. Open any order within Clover Dining
  2. Tap the three dots in the top right
  3. Select the desired menu → tap Save

The selected menu stays configured on that specific device.

docs.title: POS Login
docs.text:
Clover requires 4-digit PINs. The old POS used 3-digit PINs.

Your existing PIN still works

Add a leading zero to make it 4 digits.

Example: 253 becomes 0253.

docs.title: Unlock the device
docs.text: Enter the PIN on the screen.

docs.title: Lock the device or switch accounts
docs.text: Tap the lock button (bottom right) → enter the next PIN.

docs.title: Check Balance
docs.text:
From the home screen, open the Gift Cards app.

Swipe the gift card, or select Check Balance from the main menu.

docs.title: If the card is not active
docs.text: A dialog displays showing the card is not active.

docs.title: If the card is active
docs.text: The balance displays, along with buttons to Add Money or Print Balance.

docs.title: $5 Coupons
docs.text: A $5 coupon is applied as a discount to the item it covers.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Open the order → add the items
  2. Tap the item the coupon covers on the left → tap the blue ADD DISCOUNT text
  3. Select Coupon
  4. Pay for the discounted order normally

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Open the order → add the items
  2. Tap the green Pay button (top left)
  3. Tap the item the coupon covers on the left → tap the blue ADD DISCOUNT text
  4. Select Coupon
  5. Pay for the discounted order normally

docs.title: Load a Clover Gift Card
docs.text:
From the home screen, open the Gift Cards app.

Before loading money onto a Clover gift card, check its balance to determine whether it is already activated. Swipe the gift card — the POS shows either the current balance or a dialog reporting the card is not active.

docs.title: If the card is already activated
docs.text:
The current balance displays.

  1. Tap Add Money
  2. Select the amount of money to add → tap Next
  3. Follow the payment screen to complete the order

docs.title: If the card is not activated
docs.text:
Activating the card and loading it with money happen in the same step.

  1. Select Sell Gift Card from the main menu
  2. Select the amount of cash to load → tap Next
  3. Swipe the gift card
  4. Complete the payment screen to activate the card

The gift card balance prints with the receipt.

docs.title: Old Gift Cards
docs.text:
Clover POS devices are unable to scan old gift cards. An old gift card can be manually applied to a Clover order as a custom tender. Alternatively, the gift card can be re-issued as a Clover gift card and the balance can be transferred by issuing Store Credit.

Begin by finding the old gift card by its ID number on the old gift card database (printout). Then take note of its remaining balance and proceed below.

docs.title: Pay with an old gift card
docs.text: Take the difference between the old gift card balance and the order total to determine whether the balance covers the order in full or only part of it.

docs.title: If the balance covers only part of the order
docs.text:
1. On the payment screen, select Split Custom Amount → enter an amount equal to the old gift card balance

  2. Pay that amount with the Old Gift Card custom tender

    Note

    The Old Gift Card custom tender appears as a button on the payment screen, in the bottom half of the screen.

  3. Prompt the customer to pay for the remainder of the order with cash or credit

docs.title: If the balance exceeds the order total
docs.text:
1. Pay for the order in full with the Old Gift Card custom tender

    Note

    The Old Gift Card custom tender appears as a button on the payment screen, in the bottom half of the screen.

  2. Calculate the remaining balance to transfer:

    Transfer Balance = Old Gift Card Balance - Order Total

  3. See below for steps on how to transfer the remaining balance to a Clover gift card

docs.title: Transfer the balance to a Clover gift card
docs.text:
Use this to transfer a balance from an old gift card to a Clover gift card.

  1. Open the Gift Cards app from the home screen → select Issue Store Credit from the main menu
  2. Select the amount of credit to load onto the card → tap Next
  3. Swipe the gift card → tap Pay
  4. On the payment screen, tap $0.00 Cash → tap Pay Cash

This loads the card with the balance at a 100% discount.

docs.title: Pay with Clover Gift Card
docs.text:
A gift card is taken on the same screen as a credit card. There is no separate gift card button — swipe either card on the main payment screen.

Prerequisite

The order must be open on the payment screen. See Closing Orders → Take Payment.

Swipe the gift card. The POS reads the balance and applies it to the order.

docs.title: If the balance exceeds the order total
docs.text: The payment completes. The remaining gift card balance prints on the receipt. Return the card to the customer.

docs.title: If the balance exactly covers the order total
docs.text:
The payment completes and the card is left at a zero balance.

Reclaim the card

Take the card back from the customer. A zero-balance card is re-used the next time a gift card is purchased — reload it through Gift Cards → Load a Clover Gift Card.

docs.title: If the balance does not cover the order total
docs.text:
The POS shows the shortfall and prompts for an additional payment. Take the remainder as a second payment to close the order. The card is left at a zero balance.

Reclaim the card

Take the card back from the customer. A zero-balance card is re-used the next time a gift card is purchased — reload it through Gift Cards → Load a Clover Gift Card.

docs.title: Membership Renewal
docs.text:
1. Open the Member Link app → open an order for the member (see Opening Orders → Open Member Order (Bar))
  2. Once Member Link opens the order and sends it to the Bar Tab, tap the order

  3. From the Membership Renewals menu category, add the renewal package that matches the member's membership in Member Link

    Note

    If the member also wants to pay for their spouse, add the spouse membership renewal item as well. The spouse does not need to scan their member card.

  4. Give the customer the paper membership renewal information card → have them fill it out now and give it back

    This process needs to remain as it is currently done.

  5. Take payment from the payment screen as usual

docs.title: Sign the Book
docs.text: The existing rule of one member per order still applies. If several members at the same table all want to sign the book, only one of them can be on the table's order. Each of the others needs their own order at the bar, closed out with the $1 Daily Book item paid in cash. Follow the steps under Order just for signing the book below.

docs.title: Order just for signing the book
docs.text:
1. Open the Member Link app → scan the member card and open the order for the member
  2. Once Member Link creates the order, it shows in the Bar Tab → tap the order
  3. From the DAILY BOOK menu category, add the Daily Book item
  4. Pay for the order with $1 cash

The member has now signed the book.

docs.title: Member with an open bar tab or table order
docs.text:
1. From the DAILY BOOK menu category, add the Daily Book item to the order
  2. Double check the member is assigned to the order. This can be done from the payment screen while the order is open:
    • Tap the green Pay button to get to the payment screen
    • At the bottom under Other, select Member Link to see if the member is already assigned
    • If the member is not assigned, assign them to the order

docs.title: Credit Pre-Auth
docs.text: First, open the order in Clover Dining on the Bar Tab or at a table — see Member Order (Bar), Member Order (Table) or Non-Member Order.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Tap the three dots on the bottom bar → select Pre Auth
  2. Swipe the card to add the pre-auth

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green Pay button (top left) → tap the three dots (bottom right)
  2. Select Add Pre-Auth to add the pre-auth

docs.title: Open Member Order (Bar)
docs.text:
1. Open the Member Link app from the home screen
  2. Scan the member ID card, or type the member's name or number and tap Search
  3. Tap the member from the search results
  4. Verify membership status is active
  5. Tap New Order — Clover Dining opens and the new order appears at the top of the Bar Tab with the member's name
  6. Tap the order to open it
  7. Enter the guest count and tap Save
  8. Proceed with taking the order — go to Updating Orders → Add Items

Serving at a table?

Use Open Member Order (Table) instead.

docs.title: Open Member Order (Table)
docs.text: Open the order at the table first and assign the member afterwards. This keeps the time spent standing at the table to a minimum.

docs.title: Open the order
docs.text:
1. Open the Clover Dining app from the home screen
  2. Navigate to the Tables tab → tap the table number for the seated table
  3. Enter the guest count and tap Save
  4. Take the first items, typically appetizers — see Updating Orders → Add Items
  5. If the member presents their card and wants to sign the book: from the DAILY BOOK menu category, add the Daily Book item

docs.title: Assign the member
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the order payment screen:

    • On Station: tap the green pay button below the order summary.
    • On Flex: tap the green pay button in the top left → tap Pay.

  2. At the bottom under Other, tap Member Link

  3. Scan the member ID card, or search for the member's name or number
  4. Tap the member in the search results → tap Assign
  5. Tap Done in the top right to return to the payment screen
  6. Tap the back arrow in the bottom navigation menu to return to the order

Don't take payment yet

The payment screen is only used here to assign the member. Back out to the order — the member assignment is preserved.

Continue taking the order — go to Updating Orders → Add Items

docs.title: Open Non-Member Order
docs.text:
1. Open the Clover Dining app from the home screen
  2. Navigate to the Tables tab or the Bar Tab depending on where the customer is seated

  3. Open the order:

    • If serving at a table: tap the corresponding table number for the seated table.
    • If serving at the bar: tap the plus button (bottom right) to open a new bar tab. Under Order Type on the left, skip it for a dine-in order (it defaults to Dine-in), or select Take Out Order for a takeout order.

  4. Enter the guest count and tap Save

  5. Proceed with taking the order — go to Updating Orders → Add Items

docs.title: Takeout Order
docs.text:
Takeout is entered one of two ways:

  • A new takeout order — the whole order is takeout, usually entered by the host. Change the order's Order Type to Take Out Order.
  • Takeout added to a dine-in order — a server adds takeout food to an order that has already been served. The order stays dine-in; add the Take Out item after the takeout food.

docs.title: New takeout order
docs.text: When an order is takeout from the start, remember to change the Order Type to Take Out Order. Steps vary by device.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Open Clover Dining
  2. Tap the Bar Tab
  3. Tap the plus button (bottom right) to open a new order
  4. Under Order Type on the left, select Take Out Order
  5. Enter the guest count and tap Save
  6. Proceed with taking the order — go to Updating Orders → Add Items

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Open Clover Dining
  2. Tap the Bar Tab
  3. Tap the green plus button (bottom right)
  4. Tap the green Pay button (top left)
  5. From the dropdown in the top left, select Take Out Order
  6. Tap the back button to return to the menu → take the order

Note

The order prints to the kitchen with Take Out at the top of the ticket.

docs.title: Add takeout to a dine-in order
docs.text:
Use this when a server has already served a dine-in order and the customer wants food to take out.

  1. Open the order back up
  2. Add the takeout food item
  3. Add the Take Out item directly after it

Key difference

The order stays Dine-in. The Take Out item is a signal to the kitchen: it prints on the ticket right after the food item added before it, marking that item as takeout.

docs.title: Clock In
docs.text:
1. Open the Shifts app from the home screen
  2. Tap Clock in (bottom right)
  3. Check the box if holding cash sales this shift
  4. Tap Clock In

docs.title: Clock Out
docs.text:
1. Open the Shifts app from the home screen
  2. Tap Clock Out (bottom right)
  3. Tap Clock Out

docs.title: Employee Food Discount
docs.text:
The employee food discount is 50% off, regardless of how many hours the employee has worked that day.

The discount is applied to the food item. Once it is applied, the employee pays the discounted total as a normal payment.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Open a bar order → add the food items
  2. Tap the food item on the left → tap the blue ADD DISCOUNT text
  3. Select Employee Food Discount (50%)
  4. Pay for the discounted order normally

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Open a bar order → add the food items
  2. Tap the green Pay button (top left)
  3. Tap the food item on the left → tap the blue ADD DISCOUNT text
  4. Select Employee Food Discount (50%)
  5. Pay for the discounted order normally

docs.title: Server Shift Report
docs.text:
The shift report shows whether the house owes the server tip settlements or the server owes the house cash back.

  1. Open the Shifts app from the home screen
  2. Tap the row for the latest shift
  3. If holding cash sales, check the Holding cash sales box
  4. To declare cash tips, tap the pencil next to Cash in the Tips section → enter the amount
  5. Servers only — see the Sales by Label section for the sales breakdown. Use this to calculate the tip out amount.
  6. Tap Print report
  7. Check the Estimated Cash Settlement section. If the house owes the server cash, hand a copy of the report to the bartender for tip payout.
  8. Include the printout in the cash bag

docs.title: Add Items
docs.text:
Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from Opening Orders: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

Reminder

Ensure the guest count is correct. If needed, see Updating Orders → Modify Guest Count.

docs.title: Add an item
docs.text:
For multi-guest orders, ensure the correct guest is selected prior to adding items. Tap whole table for shared items, or tap the specific guest. On Station, the guest list is in the order summary on the left. On Flex, guests appear as icons to the right of the green dollar box — scroll horizontally to see more.

Next, add the items. The categories are listed on the full screen:

  1. Tap the category for the item — the screen opens into that category
  2. Tap the item name once to add it to the order
  3. The screen automatically returns to the category list, ready for the next item

If the item requires modifier choices, the modifier options display after the item is tapped.

docs.title: Custom Modifiers
docs.text:
A custom modifier adds a note to an item that prints to the kitchen. Custom modifiers cannot add anything that carries an additional cost. If an item needs to be added for a cost, see Updating Orders → Add Custom Item.

Tap the item in the order summary, then do one of the following:

  • Type a custom modifier — tap the Custom Modifier text box to open the keyboard
  • Change a pre-configured modifier — tap the blue pencil button next to Modifiers

There is only one custom modifier entry field. To add multiple custom modifiers, use the newline button on the keyboard to separate them.

Note

The plastic cup modifier is applied here. It is not shown by default, but it is faster to reach by tapping the blue modifiers pencil than by typing it as a custom modifier.

docs.title: Add Custom Item
docs.text:
This uses the same strategy as the old POS. If an item needs to be added to the order that is not on the menu, use one of the OPEN items. At least one OPEN item is included in each category.

  1. Tap the category where the item would usually be found
  2. Tap the OPEN item for that category — for example, OPEN FOOD - ENTREE. It is variable price, so type the price
  3. Once the item is added, tap it in the order summary
  4. Tap the Custom Modifier text box → type what the actual item is

Warning

Only use an OPEN item for exceptions. If the same item is being added this way several times per shift, bring it up to management so it can be added to the menu as a real item.

docs.title: Combining Tables
docs.text:
Two tables can be combined by merging one table into another.

Prerequisite

The orders for each of the two tables must already be created and active.

Note

The first order will be merged into the second order.

Within Clover Dining, navigate to the first order and open it.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Tap three dots from the bottom menu → tap Combine Orders
  2. Navigate to the Bar or Tables tab where the destination order resides
  3. Tap the order or table — the first order combines into the second

To verify, tap the destination order. The order summary on the left shows the moved guests with a notation in parentheses indicating which table they came from.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap three dots in the bottom right of the first order → tap Combine Orders
  2. Tap the bar or table order to merge into
  3. Tap Combine Orders to complete the merge

docs.title: Coursing & Firing
docs.text: Inventory items are preconfigured to fire to the correct printer. Firing an order sends each item to its assigned printer.

docs.title: Fire All
docs.text:
Add all items for the current round first (for example, the first round of drinks), then fire the order.

  • On Station: the Fire All button appears in the bottom left under the order summary.
  • On Flex: tap the green pay box → tap Fire All (bottom left).

docs.title: Manual Coursing
docs.text: After the first round is fired, return later to add the next round (for example, dinner after drinks). Tap Fire All again — only the newly added items fire.

docs.title: Refire or reprint an item
docs.text:
A manual refire can be triggered at any time for any item — useful when an item needs to be reprinted or modified.

  • On Station: open the order → tap three dots in the bottom menu → tap Refire to Kitchen.
  • On Flex: open the order → tap the green pay box → tap three dots (bottom right) → tap Refire to Kitchen.

The refire screen pre-checks only items that have not been fired yet. To refire an already-fired item, check its box manually, then tap Print (bottom right).

docs.title: Modify Guest Count
docs.text:
Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text: The order summary on the left displays the guest count in blue at the top. Tap the blue text → change the number of guests → tap Save.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text: The guest bar is to the right of the green dollar box. Scroll to the far right of the guest bar — the guest count appears in blue. Tap the blue count → enter the new guest count → tap Save.

docs.title: Moving Guests
docs.text:
Guests can be moved to a new table or join an already seated table.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find the order for the table or bar area where the guest is currently seated. Tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. In the order summary on the left, find the guest's row → tap three dots → tap Move Guest
  2. Select the Bar or Tables tab depending on the destination
  3. Select the bar or table order to move the guest to

After the move, the previous order displays without that guest. To see the moved guest on the new order, tap the back button in the bottom navigation menu (back arrow), then select the Bar or Tables area and tap the destination table. The moved guest appears on the order summary with a notation in parentheses showing which table they came from.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green pay button to open the order summary
  2. Find the guest → tap three dots on their guest row → tap Move Guest
  3. Select the destination Bar or Tables area
  4. Select the table number to move the guest to

After the move, the previous order opens without that guest.

Reminder

If the guest was a member and assigned to the old order, the membership assignment will need to be manually moved to the new order. Unassign the member from the previous order and reassign to the new order. See Updating Orders → Reassign Member.

docs.title: Moving Items
docs.text:
Items may need to be moved from one guest to another, or from the whole table to one guest.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. In the order summary on the left, find the guest with the item → tap three dots for that guest row → tap Move Items
  2. On the left, check the box for the item being moved
  3. In the center, choose the destination — whole table or a different guest

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green pay button to open the order summary
  2. Find the guest with the item → tap three dots for that guest row → tap Move Items
  3. Check the box for the item being moved
  4. Select the destination guest from the choices below

docs.title: Moving Tables
docs.text:
Move an entire order to a new table. Not to be confused with Updating Orders → Combining Tables.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Tap Move Order in the bottom menu bar
  2. Select An Available Table or the Bar
  3. Tap the destination table number → tap Confirm

The order is moved. Tap the destination table to open the order at its new location.

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green pay button (top left) → tap three dots (bottom right) → tap Move Order
  2. Select An Available Table or the Bar
  3. Tap the destination table → tap Confirm

The order is moved. Tap the destination table to open the order at its new location.

docs.title: Reassign Member
docs.text:
Assign or unassign a member to an order that has already been created.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: Open Member Link
docs.text:
Navigate to the order payment screen:

  • On Station: from the main order screen, tap the green pay button below the order summary.
  • On Flex: tap the green pay button in the top left → tap Pay.

Once on the payment screen, tap the Member Link button at the bottom. Member Link opens and shows any member currently assigned to the order.

docs.title: Assign a member
docs.text:
1. Search for the member's name or number, or scan the membership ID card
  2. Tap the member in the search results → tap Assign

docs.title: Unassign a member
docs.text: Tap the red X on the member chip → tap Unassign.

docs.title: Return to the order
docs.text: Tap Done in the top right to return to the payment screen, then tap the back arrow in the bottom navigation menu to return to the order. The member assignment is preserved.

docs.title: Remove or Void Items
docs.text:
If an item has been added to the order but has not been printed to the kitchen, it can be removed. If the item has been printed, it must be voided, and a reason provided.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: Remove an item
docs.text:
Steps vary by device:

  • On Station: find the item on the left order panel → tap it once → tap Delete.
  • On Flex: tap the green dollar box (top left) to open the order → find the item → tap it → tap Delete.

docs.title: Void an item
docs.text:
The steps are the same as removing an item, except there is no Delete button. There is a red Void button instead.

  • On Station: find the item on the left order panel → tap it once → tap the red Void button.
  • On Flex: tap the green dollar box (top left) to open the order → find the item → tap it → tap the red Void button.

After tapping Void, select a reason.

Note

Manager approval may be required to proceed.

docs.title: Transfer Server
docs.text:
Transfer an order to a different server. Use this when:

  • A server's shift ends while their order is still open
  • A customer moves between the bar and a table, so the order passes between the bartender and a server. Use this together with Updating Orders → Moving Guests.

Prerequisite

An order must be open on screen.

  • Continuing from another workflow: the order is already open — continue below.
  • Returning to an existing order: find it on the Tables tab or Bar Tab and tap to open.

docs.title: On Station
docs.text:
1. Tap the three dots to the right of the Pay button → under Orders & Servers, tap Transfer Server
  2. Type the name of the server to transfer to
  3. Tap the correct role → tap Transfer

docs.title: On Flex
docs.text:
1. Tap the green Pay button (top left) → tap the three dots (bottom right) → tap Transfer Server
  2. Type the name of the server to transfer to
  3. Tap the correct role → tap Transfer
